summary: Verified mobile horizontal scroll bug fix on tables across /pembelian, /produk, /pengeluaran, /pengguna, /inventory, /laporan. Tested at 390x844 (mobile portrait) and desktop 1440x900 regression. All 6 pages: container has overflow-x:auto, scrollWidth(640 or 560) > clientWidth (~316-356), and scrollLeft mutated successfully (moved to ~244-284). Desktop regression: no unwanted horizontal scroll (scrollWidth == clientWidth = 1118).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile table horizontal scroll bug fix confirmed working on all 6 target pages. Per-page measurements: /pembelian /produk /pengeluaran /pengguna: table min-width 640px, container overflowX auto, scrollable by ~284px on 390 viewport. /inventory /laporan: table min-width 560px, scrollable by ~244px. Desktop 1440 shows no unnecessary horizontal scroll (regression clean).
rca_of_the_issue: Previous wrapper used overflow-hidden which clipped horizontal overflow on narrow viewports. Fix changed wrappers to overflow-x-auto (or overflow-auto for Inventory/Reports) and applied min-w-[640px]/min-w-[560px] to <table>, forcing content wider than mobile viewport and enabling native horizontal scroll.
